# whatiuse

React components I use for product interfaces.

Documentation: https://whatiuse.minwookshin.com
Source: https://github.com/minwookshin/whatiuse

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@4.18.0 registry add @whatiuse=https://whatiuse.minwookshin.com/r/v/0.1.0-rc.43/{name}.json
npx shadcn@4.18.0 add @whatiuse/button
```

Collections: Core, Data, Analytics.
Package status: private pre-release; source registry available.
License: MIT.

Machine-readable agent contract: https://whatiuse.minwookshin.com/agent/whatiuse-agent.json
Security reports: https://github.com/minwookshin/whatiuse/security/advisories/new
